# Moku v0.15.0
**Released:** November 16, 2026
> "Your library, on every device."

## Highlights
- **Moku Sync**: pair your computer, phone and tablet over the local network and keep library, progress, bookmarks, folders and history in sync, with no account or cloud server
- **Reading history and stats from the server**: history, stats and resume points now live in Tsunagu, so they follow you across devices and survive reinstalls
- **Translatable interface**: every screen now goes through translations, with an app language setting in Settings → General
- **New leaf icon and banners**

## New Features
- Added a Sync tab to find nearby devices, pair with a code, preview what a pairing brings in, and rename or remove devices
- Synced titles a device is missing are fetched automatically, and extensions they need are installed
- Same-name folders are merged across devices
- Resume at the same page on any device
- Added an app language setting and a guide for adding languages (`docs/TRANSLATING.md`)
- Added installing extensions from a local file (#130)
- Added a bookmarked count and library filter

## Improvements
- Folders settings now live under Library, and Dev Tools under About
- Opening a title's chapter list no longer counts as a view
- Library listings can skip the server's content filter for clients that filter on their own
- DASH streams can be served as HLS for players that need it
- Server shutdown waits only a short grace period
- Per-series automation rules are kept when migrating a series
- Novel plugins share the source's cookie jar, and source cookies stay on their own host
- Bundled Tsunagu updated to 0.8.0

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed the UI scaling with window size (#132)
- Fixed extensions that need a protobuf decoder or a main dispatcher failing to load (Tsunagu#7)
- Fixed a device redialing a peer it was already connected to
- Fixed a refusal from an unknown device being treated as being unpaired
- Fixed a title's running update making a second update fail instead of waiting
- Fixed metadata matching titles that aren't in the library
- Fixed tracker dates not being pushed, and existing start dates being overwritten
- Fixed SVG covers not being cached
- Fixed FlareSolverr's page not being served when Cloudflare rejects the clearance
- Fixed config sync crashing on a bind-mounted `tsunagu.toml`
- Fixed type checking under TypeScript 7 and the issues it found, including pdf rendering on newer pdf.js

## Notes
- Moku Sync uses port `6008` (TCP) and mDNS (UDP `5353`). If a device can't be reached, allow those through the firewall. On NixOS: `networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts = [ 6008 ]` and `allowedUDPPorts = [ 5353 ]`
- Moku Sync works with Moku for Android 0.2.0 and Moku for iOS
- English is the only bundled language so far. Translations are welcome, see `docs/TRANSLATING.md`
- Moku Sync is new and needs broader testing, please report any issues
- Cloudflare/FlareSolverr support is functional but pending broader user testing
- Anime player upscaling is still work in progress and untested

## Contributors
- @LeafGithub fixed the UI scaling with window size in #132
